chunks: Fazalat ibn Ayyub, from Abdullah ibn Sinan, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
The right (boundary) of Ibrahim (peace be upon him) in Makkah was between Al-Hazwarah and Al-Mas'a. That is which was the line of Ibrahim (peace be upon him), meaning the Masjid.

key_terms.الْحَزْوَرَةِ: Al-Hazwarah, a specific location or boundary marker in Makkah
key_terms.الْمَسْعَى: Al-Mas'a, the area where Sa'ee is performed between Safa and Marwah

ai.seo_question: What is the original boundary of the Kaaba and Masjid al-Haram as defined by Prophet Ibrahim?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) clarifies that the original consecrated boundary established by Prophet Ibrahim (peace be upon him) extended specifically from Al-Hazwarah to Al-Mas'a, which constitutes the area of the Sa'ee ritual. This narration highlights the historical continuity of the Sacred Mosque's sanctity and underscores the theological significance of performing prayers within this divinely demarcated space, as recorded in al-Kafi.

en.hubeali:
Fazalat Bin Ayoub, from Abdullah Bin Sinan, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘A right of Ibrahimas in Makkah was between Al-Hazourat to the Mas’a (area of Sa’ee). So that is which was its line (boundary), meaning the Masjid’.
en.sarwar: 10. Fadalah ibn Ayyub has narrated from ‘ Abd Allah ibn Sinan who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘
The right of Ibrahim ‘Alayhi al-Salam was from al- Hazwarah to al-Mas‘a’; so it is the quarter which Ibrahim ‘Alayhi al-Salam had marked, that is, the area of the Masjid.’”
